title: •Boba Fett
caption: •Boba Fett (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}, 4: _Slave I_. May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). During battle, may target an opponent’s character present with Boba Fett. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny +2 > ability. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while with Han or Jabba).
lore: Infamous *bounty hunter*. Hired to help Jabba intimidate debtors and smugglers. Crack shot. Mandalorian armor and jet pack provide protection and flight capability.

notes: Unique. BASE CARD: the slip heading reads '•Boba Fett ( [sphere] persona only) (V)' and the sphere is the Special Edition expansion symbol (white starburst on a copper sphere, matches the SE ring on Bantha Herd / SE Boba Fett) → {set:se}; the bottom strip prints only '•Boba Fett (V)' (caption). So this slip sits on the Special Edition Boba Fett (wiki page 'Boba Fett (Dark)'), not the Cloud City one — the stub's 'Decipher base: [[Boba Fett]]' link is ambiguous (that page is the Cloud City card). Virtual Block 1 later reissued it as 'Boba Fett (Special Edition) (V)' on the SE art, which agrees. 'persona only' is set in a smaller type in the heading. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 3 / ARMOR 5; deploy 4 / forfeit 7. Yellow DS pilot icon followed by '3, 4: Slave I.' → {pilot:3}, 4: _Slave I_. (stub expands 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots, 4: Slave I'); 'Slave I' italic. Curly ‘fly’ and opponent’s. Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior. Alien (SE grey alien frame; printed icons Pilot, Warrior). Lore: wiki matches; 'bounty hunter' is bold on the 745 px scan (SE-D-bobafett.gif, tagged D-E1 = PC face, but its game text equals the printed text) — bold kept as the scan shows it. Copyright: Special Edition form, 1998 legible. Modern: VB1-D-bobafett-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 1, SE art, later revised text). Side note for the lead: vs6/29's heading sphere is the Cloud City symbol (striped Bespin), not the slip's own sphere — its {ovs} should probably be {set:cloudcity}.
